model.name: four-stage immature transit model
model.observation_model: Gaussian error on log10 density; ND contributes the normal CDF at 2 gametocytes/mL

diagnostics.alternative_model: With days 13 and 18 withheld from fitting, log10 RMSE was 0.145 for four immature stages and 0.380 for one.
diagnostics.identifiability: Production, maturation and persistence are confounded; published maturation and half-life estimates were used as explicit weak constraints.
